title: reggie
subtitle: Multi-agent system for Claude Code and its desktop companion. Branch `repo-manager`.

paragraphs.text: [[#/repo/reggie/task/vendor-fallback|Vendor-first script loading]] is waiting for a decision. Only a maintainer can approve it.

Reggie is a multi-agent system for Claude Code: 37 agents, 36 commands and a pipeline with quality gates. The product is [[#/repo/reggie/area/packages/reggie|packages/reggie]]; the Tauri desktop app under [[#/repo/reggie/area/src-tauri|src-tauri]] and [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components|src/components]] is legacy.
The product is the CLI in packages/reggie. The Tauri app (src/, src-tauri/) is the legacy Forge GUI that will be folded into the same package; do not add features to it.
Run `npm test` inside packages/reggie; the UI has no build step and is served straight from `ui/`.
Reggie read 140 of this repo's 152 code files, skipping nine CSS files, two HTML files and one Shell file; three imports pointed at no file, so the map is missing those connections.

[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components|src/components]] is a TypeScript area: [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components?lens=structure|29 source files]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components?lens=tests|20 of them tested]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components?lens=knowledge|none with a note]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components?lens=heat|changed 12 times]] in the last 30 days, mostly by [[#/repo/reggie/person/jacobpress|jacobpress]].

[[#/repo/reggie/area/packages/reggie|packages/reggie]] is a TypeScript package: [[#/repo/reggie/area/packages/reggie|21 source files]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/packages/reggie?lens=tests|12 of them tested]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/packages/reggie?lens=knowledge|seven with a note]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/packages/reggie?lens=heat|changed 41 times]] in the last 30 days, mostly by [[#/repo/reggie/person/jacobpress|jacobpress]]. It stands alone: nothing else in the repo imports it.

[[#/repo/reggie/area/src-tauri|src-tauri]] is a Rust crate: 18 source files, [[#/repo/reggie/area/src-tauri?lens=knowledge|two with a note]], [[#/repo/reggie/area/src-tauri?lens=heat|changed three times]] in the last 30 days.

[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/hooks|src/hooks]] — five source files, no note
[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/types|src/types]] — seven source files, no note
[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/services|src/services]] — three source files, one with a note
[[#/repo/reggie/area/src|src (other)]] — five loose source files including [[#/repo/reggie/file/src/main.tsx|main.tsx]]
A user action starts in [[#/repo/reggie/file/src/main.tsx?dir=down&depth=2|src/main.tsx]] and reaches the Rust side through 48 Tauri commands defined in [[#/repo/reggie/area/src-tauri|src-tauri]].

chips.label: Kind
chips.tip: Entry kind: main — the file the bundler starts from.

paragraphs.text: The command line starts in [[#/repo/reggie/file/packages/reggie/src/cli.ts?dir=down&depth=2|cli.ts]] (27 commands); agents reach the same code through [[#/repo/reggie/file/packages/reggie/src/mcp.ts?dir=down&depth=2|mcp.ts]] (10 tools); the web view is served by [[#/repo/reggie/file/packages/reggie/src/serve.ts?dir=down&depth=2|serve.ts]] (8 routes).
[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components|src/components]] leans on [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/types|src/types]] 41 times, mostly for [[#/repo/reggie/file/src/types/terminal.ts|terminal.ts]] (21).
[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components|src/components]] calls into [[#/repo/reggie/area/src-tauri|src-tauri]] through 27 Tauri commands (matched by name).
[[#/repo/reggie/area/src/hooks|src/hooks]] and [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/services|src/services]] depend on each other.

chips.label: Cycle
chips.tip: These two areas import each other; changes ripple both ways.
